focus: Q5 and Q6: compare the 13 /create:* command contracts with their sk-doc mode contracts (flags, defaults, outputs); count sk-design chart forms and diagram types against the 29 and 27 claims; re-run the sk-doc skill validator in check mode on sk-code and sk-design.

Do the /design:* commands and sk-design modes match their stated counts (29 chart forms, 27 diagram types) and catalog files?

label: The create-command index advertises 21 chart forms while the catalog ships 29: README.txt:50 says 'a catalog of 21 forms', but the chart catalog has 29 data rows between its sentinels, 29 template files render them, /design:chart says 29 and sk-design-chart/SKILL.md:114 says 'twenty-nine chart forms'. The stale count is present at tag v4.0.0.0 and unchanged at v4.0.2.0, so it is a baseline defect carried through the v4 line.

The create-command index puts the two design commands inside the create tree: README.txt:83 and :85 list chart.md and diagram.md under create/, but neither file exists there and both live under .skilled/commands/design/. The same index says section 3 lists every command in this folder while that table also carries the two /design:* rows, so the document mixes two command folders and breaks the single-folder invariant it states.

/create:readme advertises --output <path> but no bound asset reads it: readme.md:3 offers the flag, while create-readme-presentation.txt's resolution table ends at execution_mode and no --output or output_path token appears in any of the three bound assets. A user who supplies the advertised flag gets default behavior with no error.

/create:benchmark advertises --benchmark-id <id> but no bound asset reads it: benchmark.md:3 offers the flag, while create-benchmark-presentation.txt's field table lists benchmark_family, operation, benchmark_date, skill_path and execution_mode with no benchmark_id field, and the token appears nowhere in the workflow YAMLs or the packet. The flag is a no-op the setup path silently ignores.

/create:changelog narrows --bump to four values while the contract accepts five: changelog.md:3 lists major|minor|patch|build, but sk-create-changelog/SKILL.md:64 allows major, minor, patch, build or auto and create-changelog-auto.yaml:139 validates exactly that five-value set with auto as the default. The hint hides a value the engine accepts.

Add a command-contract lint that cross-checks argument-hint against the bound assets: three of the 13 create commands advertise a flag the assets do not consume (--output, --benchmark-id) or a value set narrower than the mode contract (--bump), and no current check reads argument-hint against the presentation or YAML. A check-command-contract.cjs under sk-doc/shared/scripts/ could parse each hint for --flag tokens and assert each appears in the command's presentation contract or workflow YAMLs, catching f-iter003-003 through f-iter003-005; nothing breaks if it is never built, but those defects stay invisible to CI.

Q6 counts are exact. Chart: 29 data rows between CHART_CATALOG sentinels, 29 template files, six distinct families (comparison 6, composition 6, time 9, distribution 4, relationship 3, matrix 1) and three --system values covering every row (neutral 14, categorical 11, ordered 4). Diagram: 27 catalog rows, 27 canonical type files, and the SKILL.md 38-form library decomposes as 27 canonical + 7 pattern variants + 4 skin starters. Both corpus checks return RESULT: PASSED with errors: 0.

Q3 check-mode confirmation: validate_skill_package.py --strict reports package_skill.py --check --strict PASS, compiled routing readiness PASS and parent-skill-check.cjs PASS for both .skilled/skills/sk-code and .skilled/skills/sk-design, exit 0; the --json form returns valid: true. No check fails.

The command set itself is complete: all 13 command files resolve their three bound assets (39 files), and mode-registry.json names exactly those 13 command files and declares command: null for sk-create-frontmatter and sk-create-quality-control. The defects are flag-level and index-level, not missing files.

The two dead flags are not consumed anywhere in the run directory: --benchmark-id/benchmark_id appears only in the command hint and the create index, and --output/output_path does not appear in the readme assets at all. Both were already present at tag v4.0.0.0.

direction: The /design:chart 29-form and /design:diagram 27-type claims overstate or understate their catalogs
reason: 29 catalog rows equal 29 template files and 27 catalog rows equal 27 canonical files; the 38-form diagram library decomposes as 27+7+4; both corpus checks pass with errors: 0
